verify.title: Implementation check · {name}
verify.failNote: The implementation is broken here: it does not open, throws errors, fails a flow the prototype passes, or has a serious accessibility defect. Developers fix these.
verify.diffNote: The implementation differs from the approved prototype. For each one a designer decides: a defect for developers, or an intended change. An intended change needs an approved decision (verify.py accept <name> <ID> --decision D-…).
verify.noDecisions: No decisions in the log are scoped to these screens or this app.
verify.imagesNote: Side-by-side images (prototype · implementation · differences) are in side/, raw screenshots in shots/.
